name: Yuno
source:
A bright, energetic and frank girl. She's easily moved to tears and will sympathetically cry for other people.
She loves merrymaking, gossiping, and meddling with other people.
A very well-informed person, she prides herself on her intelligence gathering skills.
She can gather information very fast, but the veracity of that info is a little doubtful.
